units.source_text: 然而，水池对岸的树丛中，马醉木也腼腆地开着白花。

en.t: Yet, among the trees on the far side of the pond, the andromeda too was shyly blooming with white flowers.

units.source_text: 那里有许多松树，虽未成材，却也千姿百态。

en.t: There were many pine trees there; though they had not yet grown into timber, they took on countless graceful forms.

units.source_text: 倘使没有樱花，那劲松的翠绿倒也引人入胜。

en.t: If there were no cherry blossoms, the fresh green of those vigorous pines would itself be captivating.

units.source_text: 不，就是现在，松木的蓊郁青翠和池子的悠悠绿水，也能把垂樱的簇簇红花，衬得更加鲜艳夺目。

en.t: No, even now, the lush blue-green of the pines and the deep, lingering green of the pond water made the clustered red blossoms of the weeping cherry stand out all the more vividly.
